summary: Cut each replication exchange to the envelopes whose serialized body fits under the 64 MiB a peer inflates to, so a backlog page of large envelopes no longer fails as 'the exchange body inflates past 67108864 bytes' on every attempt and moves nothing

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; members may upgrade in any order.

compatibility.detail: An exchange carries fewer envelopes when they would not fit; the rest go in later exchanges. Older peers receive smaller bodies and need no change. An envelope that cannot fit alone fails the exchange with the typed error replication-envelope-too-large instead of an oversized body. No wire change.

downtime.detail: A daemon restart to install the build; no extra interruption.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary freely; nothing is persisted.
